design.assignment_rule: Slot s = 0, 1, 2, ... per participant (scripts/local_server_face.py, code F<s>-XXXX-XXXX; ?slot=s; without a server a random s in 0-3, code FX<s>-XXXX-XXXX). Rotation r = s mod 2: the window of rank k (group ids sorted) shows comparison (k + r) mod 2; side flip = (s mod 2) XOR ((s div 2) mod 2): variant 1 when (k + flip) is even. Every block of 4 slots shows each window x comparison equally often in both variants. Screen order from the code (cyrb53 + mulberry32). analysis/study_plan_all.py mirrors it.
design.full_view_rule: each of the two videos must reach its end (ended event, or currentTime >= duration - 0.2 s) with at least 90 % of its length actually played (0.1-s bins), at least once; then the questions unlock
design.seed_rule: seed = cyrb53 hash of the participant code; PRNG = mulberry32(seed): the same code gives the same order, sides and comparisons (index_face.html?code=XXXX). analysis/analyze_responses_face.py rebuilds the plan (analysis/study_plan_all.py).
design.attention_check_rule: none (no attention screen in the face study)

rules: Quarantined: not an answers file, synthetic, other study_version or instrument, unfinished, stored plan different from the rebuilt plan, a screen missing / out of order, answers missing or invalid, videos not played to the end, duplicate code (the earliest file kept), pilot files, test sessions (test_mode).
Excluded: more than 1 screen skipped because a video did not load.

welcome: The purpose of this user study is to include human judgement in the evaluation of our results. It takes about 6 minutes.

You will see short conversation clips: the real partner on the left, and on the right two versions of a grey face that reacts to them. For each pair, you choose which face reacts more appropriately and which one moves more naturally: top, bottom, or no clear difference.
Please do not judge the quality of the mesh or the visual appearance. Base your answers only on the movement.
Your answers are anonymous: no personal information is collected, only your choices and a random participant code.

F.title: Faces
intro: Close-up: left the real partner's face (Speaker); right, top and bottom, two versions of the GREY face (Reactor).
Play each reactor with the speaker. Only the face is shown, always facing forward; only the expression differs.

questions.text: Which face is the **more appropriate** reaction to the partner, while listening and while speaking?
questions.hint: Expressions at the right moment; a face alive with its own voice.
Smooth expressions, no frozen or jerky face; the mouth follows the voice.

questions.text: When the grey person speaks, which mouth **follows the voice** better?
questions.hint: Lips opening and closing with the words.
